note: 1.21.1 made ClickableWidget/ButtonWidget.render (class_339.method_25394) final and moved the override point to the protected method_48579 (renderWidget, implemented by class_4264). Any converted class that still declares/overrides method_25394 fails to load with IncompatibleClassChangeError. This generic rule renames every such declaration to method_48579 and rewrites its invokespecial super call, so the drawing code keeps running.

Renaming keeps the drawing code instead of deleting it.
